About us

A work of faith, rooted in Montréal

“Kimia na motema” means “peace of the heart” in Lingala. That is what we hope to bring, one encounter at a time.

The Christian association La Paix du Cœur / Kimia Na Motema is a work inspired by the Lord Yehoshua (Jesus), carried by a group of Christians moved by the love of Elohim and by compassion for people in need. We serve humbly and selflessly, for the glory of Elohim alone. Founded in 2014 in Montréal, Canada, this vision was born to bring support and hope to orphans.

Our mission

Our mission

By the grace of the Lord, the Provider and Rewarder of those who seek him, the Christian association La Paix du Cœur’s mission is to reveal to the nations the Heart of the Lord, turned toward the weakest: widows, widowers, orphans, the poor and the homeless, regardless of language, colour or race. Working in a spirit of love and service, this non-profit Christian association offers everything free of charge, for the glory of Elohim alone.

Values

What guides us

  1. 01

    Dignity

    We show hope rather than need. First names only, never an exact location, always with consent.

  2. 02

    Proximity

    We act in our own streets and neighbourhoods, in small, personal teams.

  3. 03

    Free of charge

    Everything we offer is free, unconditional and regardless of language, colour or race.

  4. 04

    Prayer

    Every activity begins and ends in prayer. We serve for the glory of Elohim alone.
